explanation: The October 28, 2015 statement introduced a materially hawkish shift by explicitly referencing the 'next meeting' as a potential liftoff date ('In determining whether it will be appropriate to raise the target range at its next meeting'), replacing the prior document's more open-ended forward guidance; this direct signal of an imminent December rate hike was a substantive policy communication that plausibly caused a structural break in financial markets on that date.
